name: v225_model_option_chain_no_reversal
hypothesis: Fscore contrarian, long-tenor option convexity, and slow sparse-news-chain staleness are individually occupied, but a balanced no-open-close blend may create a different daily-PnL path while avoiding direct fscore/open-close and option/alltype siblings.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_growth, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(vec_avg(scl12_alltype_sentvec), 20), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms), 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry), -1)
notes: No close/open sleeve; strict-check against 3q7jJ130, Vkpeno3w, WjpJwMdP, RRplYRpo, and news-chain actives.

name: v225_treasury_chain_model_calm
hypothesis: Balance-sheet investment-sale discipline may be more independent when paired with sparse event-chain timing and a small fscore contrarian component, rather than option/PCR/profitability sleeves that were occupied in v209.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_siv / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_ivch / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_msa) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(novelty_chain_elapsed_ms), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Avoids treasury+option, treasury+PCR, treasury+cash-profit siblings; kill if it maps to O0p2bElq, 2r72v5P8, or KPb2n2WE.

name: v225_recommendation_chain_fscore_lowrisk
